summary: Each Call Assist feature has its own toggle in the Phone app's settings. Genuinely disableable — the AI listening to your calls is opt-out, one switch at a time.

steps.path: Phone app → ☰ → Settings → Call Assist → open each feature and toggle it off (Call Screen, Hold for Me, live transcription)

collateral: spam call screening stops, so unknown numbers ring through
Hold for Me and call transcripts are gone
whyTheyDidIt: Call features are the most defensible AI on the phone — which is also why Google is comfortable letting you turn them off.

sources.label: Gadget Hacks — turn off Call Assist features in the Phone app
